title: Constrained Tagging for Span Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.28922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative LLMs can label spans without task-specific training, but their output is not tied to positions in the input: a returned span may be absent from the input or occur several times. We present constrained tagging, a training-free method in which the model reproduces the input and wraps each span in labeled inline markup. A logits processor using a byte-level token trie and a finite-state machine admits only tokens that continue the input verbatim or form a valid tag, so the output reproduces the input exactly with labels from the given set, and spans may begin or end at any character boundary, even inside a token. Two-phase decoding lets reasoning models reason before the constraint engages. translated_title: 面向片段标注的受限标记方法
translated_abstract: 生成式大语言模型无需任务特定训练即可对文本片段进行标注，但其输出并未与输入中的位置绑定：返回的片段可能不在输入中出现，或者出现多次。我们提出了“受限标记”（constrained tagging），这是一种无需训练的方法，让模型逐字复现输入，并用带标签的内联标记包裹每个片段。一个使用字节级词元trie与有限状态机的logits处理器，只允许那些逐字延续输入或构成有效标签的词元，因此输出能够精确复现输入，且标签来自给定集合，片段可以在任意字符边界处开始或结束，甚至可以在词元内部。两阶段解码使推理模型能够在约束生效之前先进行推理。在六个数据集和六个开源权重模型上，该保证在255,312次受限生成中仅有0.022%的失败，每次失败都是因为推理模型耗尽了词元预算或从未结束其推理过程，且该约束没有增加可测量的
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的受限标记方法，通过字节级词元trie和有限状态机约束模型逐字复现输入并内联标注片段，从而保证片段标注输出与输入位置精确对应，且几乎不产生失败。
en_tdlr: A training-free constrained tagging method uses a byte-level token trie and finite-state machine to force LLMs to reproduce the input verbatim with inline span labels, guaranteeing position-tied span annotations with a failure rate of only 0.022%.
